Definition: to forage for straw, stubble or wood; figuratively, to assemble
BiblicalUsage: 1) to gather, assemble, collect, gather stubble or sticks; 1a) (Qal) to gather together; 1b) (Poel) to gather stubble; 1c) (Hithpoel) to gather oneself together
